excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <protolambda> FYI: currently the consensus specs define the extra_data field as a SSZ byte list with a limit of 32 bytes. This is kind of a bad hybrid between dynamic size like eth1, and 32 byte graffiti like in eth2. If you prepare an execution genesis config, and plan to start a consensus chain with merge at slot 0, then make sure you keep the extra-data short enough. I'd like to change this type definition to either be fixed-length 32 bytes, or have more capacity, but we'll stick to the current thing for interop stability
